rows.notes: Only the CBA was found for the exact term; trade pages say 'cap charges' or 'cap number'. Before the regular season only the 51 highest-valued contracts count in full (Art. 13 Sec. 5-6).

rows.statement: tender: A one-year contract offer a club must make to keep rights to a player (a draftee, exclusive rights or restricted player, or a tagged player), with the rights depending on the tender type.

sources.citation: NFL-NFLPA Collective Bargaining Agreement 2020, Art. 1 (Definitions) (NFL-NFLPA CBA (primary text))

rows.statement: termination pay: Pay owed to a player with four or more years of credited service who is released after his club's first regular season game (having made the active/inactive list): the unpaid balance of that year's Paragraph 5 salary, less any guaranteed salary.

rows.statement: transition tag: A designation that lets the player shop himself while his club keeps a right of first refusal, with no draft compensation, at a tender equal to the greater of the top-ten positional average or 120% of his salary.

sources.citation: NFL-NFLPA Collective Bargaining Agreement 2020, Art. 10 Sec. 5 (NFL-NFLPA CBA (primary text))

rows.statement: UFA tender: A one-year offer an old club may make by the Monday after the draft to an unrestricted free agent still unsigned; if he stays unsigned after July 22 he may sign only with that club, at 110% of his prior-year salary.

sources.citation: NFL-NFLPA Collective Bargaining Agreement 2020, Art. 9 Sec. 1(b)(i) (NFL-NFLPA CBA (primary text))
sources.quote: a one year Player Contract of at least 110% of either (a) his Prior Year Salary

rows.notes: Single publisher. The tender counts on Team Salary from July 15 or the first day of camp, whichever is later (Art. 13 Sec. 5(b)(iv)).

rows.statement: undrafted free agent: A player who was eligible for the draft but not picked, free to sign with any club after the draft; his first contract runs three years.

sources.citation: NFL-NFLPA Collective Bargaining Agreement 2020, Art. 6 Sec. 11 (NFL-NFLPA CBA (primary text))

rows.statement: unrestricted free agent: A veteran with four or more accrued seasons whose contract has expired, free to sign with any club with no compensation owed.

sources.citation: NFL-NFLPA Collective Bargaining Agreement 2020, Art. 1 (Definitions) (NFL-NFLPA CBA (primary text))

rows.statement: vested veteran: A player with four or more years of credited service, who if released between the Monday after the Super Bowl and the trade deadline is not subject to waivers and can sign with any club at once.

rows.statement: vesting guarantee: A guarantee (usually injury-only at first) that becomes fully guaranteed on a set date if the player is still on the roster then.

rows.statement: veteran salary benefit: A rule that lets a club sign a veteran with four or more credited seasons to a one-year minimum contract (plus a capped extra) while counting only the minimum for a two-year veteran against its cap; the gap is counted as a league-wide player benefit.

Four-Year Qualifying Contract allows up to $1.25M more base salary for players kept four straight years (Sec. 7).
